doc: Allowlist of migrations whose SQL was NOT produced by `drizzle-kit generate`. Every entry must have a rationale that survives a code review. The migration-journal validator hard-fails on hand-written migrations (`ADD CONSTRAINT` outside DO $$ block, `DROP CONSTRAINT` without IF EXISTS, missing snapshot) UNLESS their tag appears here AND meets the per-tag conditions below.

custom.rationale: PG PL/pgSQL trigger (enforce_account_membership_seat_limit) plus BEFORE INSERT / UPDATE OF status trigger on account_memberships — DB-level backstop for the app-level guard at apps/server/src/lib/seat-count-guard.ts. CR8-P2-03 defense-in-depth. Not expressible in Drizzle's schema DSL (no schema changes; trigger + function only).
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Snapshot would be a copy of 0006's snapshot (this migration adds no Drizzle-modeled columns/tables), but is omitted to avoid confusion, matching the 0002_triggers_search_vectors precedent.

custom.rationale: Hand-written ALTER TABLE on jobs adding locked_by/locked_until/last_error columns plus a partial index on (locked_until) WHERE state = 'active'. CR8-P2-01 phase A — durable work queue visibility-timeout semantics. drizzle-kit can model the columns but not the partial-index predicate (WHERE clause inside CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS), and the ADD COLUMN statements are wrapped in IF NOT EXISTS for idempotent re-apply. Companion Drizzle schema update at packages/db/src/schema/jobs.ts adds the columns + partial index for type-safety; callers query via Drizzle, not raw SQL.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as 0003: snapshot regeneration via `pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate` against a clean DB once the shared-facts/yjs/shared-memory debt is worked through. Deferred to keep phase A scoped.

custom.rationale: Hand-written CREATE TABLE + indexes for the `unreconciled_webhooks` table. The table was defined in packages/db/src/schema/webhook-reconciliation.ts and already appears in the Drizzle snapshots at meta/0006_snapshot.json and meta/0009_snapshot.json, but NO .sql migration ever created it (verified 2026-04-22: grep -n 'unreconciled' migrations/*.sql → zero hits). Production likely has the table from an ad-hoc drizzle-kit push at some point (webhooks.ts writes to it at runtime; if prod didn't have it, webhook processing would be failing). Migration uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS so it is safe to apply against both fresh DBs (creates it) and prod (no-op). Partial index `unreconciled_webhooks_unresolved_idx` on (created_at) WHERE resolved_at IS NULL is not expressible in Drizzle's schema DSL beyond the .where() modifier.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Snapshot already captures the table (meta/0006_snapshot.json + meta/0009_snapshot.json reference it). Missing snapshot for this tag specifically because it's a retroactive catch-up for an unmigrated table; the canonical snapshot state is the 0009 snapshot. Full snapshot regen deferred to the general snapshot-debt backfill tracked alongside 0003/0004/0005/0008.

custom.rationale: A.3 of the post-v1 MCP arc — adds two nullable columns (`duration_ms` bigint, `errored` boolean) to `usage_meters` so the new `/admin/mcp` Usage tab can plot p50/p95 duration buckets + success/error rate per meterName. Hand-written with `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS` so it's idempotent against any prod environment that already applied an ad-hoc `drizzle-kit push` for the schema change. drizzle-kit produces functionally equivalent SQL (`ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN ...` without the IF NOT EXISTS guard), but the descriptive tag + idempotency match the 0010 precedent for this kind of small column-addition migration.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as 0003/0004/0005/0008/0010: `pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate` against a clean DB once the broader snapshot-debt backfill happens. Drizzle schema change at packages/db/src/schema/accounts.ts already adds the columns at the type level; consumers query via Drizzle, not raw SQL, so the type contract is intact.

custom.rationale: I-1 from Phase 1 payment audit: licenses.user_id had ON DELETE CASCADE, silently destroying license rows (billing audit evidence) when a user was deleted. drizzle-kit generate cannot express a FK-mode change (CASCADE → SET NULL) without dropping and re-adding the constraint, which it does non-idempotently. Hand-written to use bare DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS + DO $$ ADD CONSTRAINT ... EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object for full idempotency. Companion Drizzle schema change at packages/db/src/schema/licenses.ts changes the FK option and makes userId nullable.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as prior entries: `pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate` against a clean DB once the broader snapshot-debt backfill happens. Drizzle schema change at licenses.ts already reflects the nullable userId + SET NULL FK so type consumers are correct.

custom.rationale: I-2 from Phase 1 payment audit: GDPR Article 17 erasure path never called stripe.customers.del, leaving EU PII in Stripe. Adds stripe_deletion_status (text, CHECK IN ('deleted','failed')) and stripe_deletion_at (timestamptz) to users table to record Stripe-side erasure outcome. Hand-written with ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS + DO $$ CHECK CONSTRAINT ... EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object for idempotency. drizzle-kit generates ADD COLUMN without IF NOT EXISTS guard; the idempotency requirement mandates the hand-written form per the 0011 precedent.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as prior entries. Drizzle schema change at packages/db/src/schema/users.ts adds stripeDeletionStatus and stripeDeletionAt columns at the type level; consumers query via Drizzle ORM.

custom.rationale: GAP-340 P1 fleet knowledge graph: CREATE TABLE for kg_episodes/kg_nodes/kg_edges/kg_edge_episodes/kg_node_aliases/kg_outbox. Hand-written because the migration adds pgvector vector(768) columns + HNSW indexes (vector_cosine_ops), tsvector GENERATED ALWAYS AS STORED columns + GIN indexes, and partial current-edge indexes (WHERE invalid_at IS NULL AND expired_at IS NULL) — none expressible in Drizzle's schema DSL, following the 0002_triggers_search_vectors precedent. All statements are CREATE ... IF NOT EXISTS with inline REFERENCES/CHECK (no ALTER ADD CONSTRAINT), idempotent against fresh + re-applied environments. Companion Drizzle schema at packages/db/src/schema/knowledge-graph.ts models the plain columns for ORM typing.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as 0002/0003/0008: `pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate` against a clean DB once the pgvector-column snapshot debt is worked through. The Drizzle schema at knowledge-graph.ts already reflects the tables at the type level; the graph package queries retrieval-heavy paths via raw SQL and Drizzle inserts otherwise.

custom.rationale: GAP-349 FTS name-normalization fix: kg_nodes carried real fleet-scan rows on Neon with `revkg search "electric proxy"` returning 0 hits, because Postgres's english tsvector parser tokenizes file/path-like names (`electric-proxy.ts`, `apps/admin/src/lib/api/electric-proxy.ts`) as single opaque tokens, so word-level `websearch_to_tsquery` queries never matched. Adds `search_text` (a normalized name+naturalKey+summary rendering written by the ingest engine on every node upsert; separators/camelCase-boundaries become spaces, no regex per the fleet no-regex rule) and drops+recreates the generated `search` tsvector column to index it instead of name+summary (Postgres has no ALTER COLUMN ... SET EXPRESSION). Not expressible via drizzle-kit generate because it both backfills existing rows (DML) and rebuilds a GENERATED STORED column plus its dependent GIN index, following the 0021 precedent for this table. All statements are idempotent (ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS / DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS / CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS). Backfill scope: this migration's SQL backfill normalizes separators only (plain replace(), no regex); camelCase-boundary normalization is not expressible in plain SQL and completes incrementally as each node is re-upserted by a future scan (the ingest engine always writes full normalization; see the migration's header comment). Companion Drizzle schema change at packages/db/src/schema/knowledge-graph.ts adds the searchText column.
custom.snapshotDebtNote: Same regen path as 0021: `pnpm --filter @revealui/db db:generate` against a clean DB once the pgvector-column snapshot debt is worked through. The Drizzle schema at knowledge-graph.ts already reflects searchText at the type level; the graph package queries retrieval-heavy paths via raw SQL and Drizzle inserts otherwise.
